report.clinical_summary: Patient has CLL in very early stages with slightly elevated white blood cell count. Currently on watchful waiting with no medication. Reports intermittent fatigue after work for about a month and a new pea-sized neck lump noticed by wife two weeks ago. No other concerning symptoms. Has regular three-month follow-ups with hematologist. Family history of CLL (father had it). Trusts the care being received.
